staff_id.description:
Unique auto-generated identifier for the non-faculty staff member.
Prefixed with STF and used as the polymorphic target ID in money transaction tables.

name.description:
The full legal name of the staff member.
Used in payroll processing, HR lists, and display references on admin dashboards.

role.description:
The designated organizational role of the staff member (e.g. admin, receptionist, security, cleaner).
Helps define operational boundaries and access permissions.

status.description:
Indicates if the staff member is currently active or inactive.
Inactive staff are hidden from active rosters and cannot be selected for new payouts.

phone.description:
Contact telephone number of the staff member.
Used for HR communication and verifying identity details.

email.description:
The official email address of the staff member.
Used for sending payment receipts, account notifications, and communication logs.
